<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Repo rate hike:</strong> The RBI increased the repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%, marking the first hike in nearly four years, while raising the FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1% and CPI inflation projection to 5.2%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxQTjBpS09LRTFGOC11Z3BpYS0xY1NLdXY4NEZaTXF6eHhCVjgtVUg2dDFsWURWeG9OTUhSaTk3VnVSaXFvME5fOENnd0oxZGgzN2hsWFVUVzdiY05LUGxMc3N3cDVEWi15X09WMUJ0X3pIZ0xMdWhxb1JxWkdlUVY1QnZkd01pTkJWMmdFSHloVUVXQm5MUDZOVi0zUW52Uzc0ZjdPWnhBRlFQck1ZclZqTTZPRQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi_?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I53</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market volatility:</strong> Indian equity indices experienced initial declines following the policy announcement, though banking stocks saw a subsequent recovery as the market digested the hawkish shift.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I94</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional flows:</strong> On October 6, FIIs were net sellers of Indian equities worth Rs 2,961 crore, while DIIs provided support with net purchases of Rs 5,089 crore.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I101</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Yield and currency impact:</strong> Following the rate hike, Indian bond yields rose to 7.27% and the rupee faced pressure, reflecting the central bank&#x27;s move to address global uncertainty and domestic inflation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
